children: The stock market seems complicated, but it doesn't have to be. ChartWatch LIVE Webinars take the guesswork and confusion out of investing by teaching you a clear set of investing rules to allocate your capital and help you manage risk in the markets.

In this week's edition, I examine, chart by chart, the critical stock, bond and commodity markets to watch that could signal whether the hyped AI trade is about to turn and, if so, whether a broader stock market crash could unfold.
Click the "Watch on YouTube" button in the player above, or go to our YouTube page, to check out our other fantastic technical analysis videos when you're done with this one!
If you weren't able to make the live webinar, or if you haven't registered yet, then I hope you can join me Wednesday, 4 November, at 12:00pm AEDTfor the next instalment.

Learn more about technical analysis and trend following through real case studies on ASX stocks. Australia's premier technical analyst, Carl Capolingua, shares his unique insights on stocks as requested by viewers. Ask about a company in your portfolio or anything related to trading and investing and get Carl's expert opinion.
Stock markets are rebounding as Anthropic’s IPO filing appears to have reignited interest in the AI trade.
But falls in stocks and commodities in September and October, particularly mining stocks, have left investors with more questions than answers.
We review the charts and markets with a track record of flagging major market dislocations well before headlines of a crash appear in the papers.

title: The AI stocks crash is coming, here's what to do about it
